turns.text: Actually, I saved some money and brought lunch from home. I packed a DIY container of cilantro lime rice, black beans, corn salsa, and grilled chicken, all mixed together like a burrito without the tortilla. It was really satisfying!

turns.text: Yum, a homemade burrito bowl is always a great choice. How are things going with Tom and the wedding planning? Summer 2028 will be here before you know it!

turns.text: We're doing really well, thank you! We actually spent some time looking at venue photos online last night. It's nice to take our time with it since we have a couple of years, so there's no rush or stress yet.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That sounds like a very relaxed and enjoyable way to plan. Have you had any time for your sourdough baking lately, or has work been keeping you too busy?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: It's been a little busy, but I did feed my starter yesterday evening. I'm hoping to get a loaf started this weekend if my schedule stays clear. It's always so therapeutic for me.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: There really is nothing like the smell of fresh bread. I hope you get that baking time this weekend! Have a wonderful rest of your shift today, Sofia.

turns.speaker: user
